schema_title: GDPR Art. 30 Processing Activities Records Schema

field_descriptions.name_and_contact_details: Art. 30(1)(a): name and contact details of controller and DPO
field_descriptions.third_country_transfers: Art. 30(1)(e): transfers to third countries or international organisations
field_descriptions.retention_periods: Art. 30(1)(f): envisaged time limits for erasure
field_descriptions.security_measures: Art. 30(1)(g): general description of technical and organisational security measures per Art. 32

art30_exemption.note: Organisations with fewer than 250 employees are exempt UNLESS processing is non-occasional, likely to result in risk, or involves special category data (Art. 9) or criminal conviction data (Art. 10).
